notes: PLACEHOLDER THRESHOLDS - NOT CLINICALLY VALIDATED. Seated, facing the phone: abduction happens in the image plane, so the 2D shoulder angle (hip-shoulder-elbow) tracks it well. Arms hang at ~5-15 deg; shoulder height is ~90 deg. Wrist is deliberately not required so a framing that crops the hands still counts. exitDeg is 40 (not lower) because a trunk lean adds directly to the resting shoulder angle: at a 25 deg lean, hanging arms already read ~35 deg.
